Name: Wedding Reminder
Author: handwrittenhello
Description:
Have you ever shown up to your wedding in the campiest clothes Pelican Town has to offer by accident? Do you want a celebratory message the day before your wedding to pop up on the screen?

[img]https://i.ibb.co/4wyjDwV6/image.png[/img]
Wedding Reminder sends a message to the HUD the morning of your wedding, and every time you re-enter the farmhouse that day, to make sure you don't forget your big day tomorrow. 

There are existing entries for every vanilla spouse you can marry, and additional entries with custom messages can be added via Content Patcher. 

[size=4][u]For Players[/u][/size]
How to install: 
1. Ensure you have SMAPI installed
2. Download the file from here or Github
3. Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]. Make sure both the C# and CP folders are included.
4. Launch the game using SMAPI

[size=4][u]For Mod Authors[/u][/size]
To add or edit custom keys, target handwrittenhello.weddingReminder/HUDMessage and write your desired entry. The key [b]must [/b]be the spouse's internal name, or else the default message will show. Example: 

[code]{﻿
    "Action": "EditData",
    "Target": "handwrittenhello.weddingReminder/HUDMessage",
    "Entries": {
     "Leah": "I want Leah's entry to say this instead!",
     "{{ModId}}_MyInternalNPCName": "You're getting married to MyNPCName tomorrow!"
    }
}[/code]
Source code can be found [url=https://github.com/nbeymer99/WeddingReminder]here on Github[/url].
